Lead a portfolio of Brand clients in Canada, with particular focus on CPG, Food & Beverage and consumer-facing categories, delivering strategic, insight-led creator marketing programs that drive brand and business impact.

Serve as a senior strategic advisor to clients, building trusted relationships and helping senior marketers navigate the rapidly evolving creator and social landscape.

Develop creator strategies rooted in consumer insight, culture, audience behavior and brand objectives, translating those strategies into breakthrough creative and creator-led programs.

Partner with the Head of Creator, North America and cross-regional leaders to align strategy, standards, innovation and best practices across markets.

Lead, mentor and inspire high-performing teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, creative ambition and excellence.

Drive operational rigor, process improvement and best practices within the Creator Marketing discipline.

Play a leadership role in new business development, including pitches, proposals, prospecting and organic account growth.

Stay at the forefront of creator, platform, cultural and consumer trends, bringing forward emerging opportunities for clients and the broader business.

WHO YOU ARE

A proven creator marketing leader with a strong track record of building culturally relevant programs for major consumer brands.

•

Deeply knowledgeable about CPG, Food & Beverage and/or adjacent consumer categories, with an understanding of how creators influence awareness, consideration, trial, loyalty and advocacy.

A trusted senior client partner who listens deeply, challenges constructively and can translate business and brand challenges into compelling creator strategies.

Culturally fluent, with a strong instinct for emerging creators, communities, platforms, formats and behaviors.

An inclusive, collaborative leader who thrives in matrixed, fast-paced environments.

Curious, future-focused and continuously learning.

10+ years of relevant experience in creator/influencer marketing, communications, social, digital marketing or related fields.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

Demonstrated success leading creator marketing strategies for major consumer brands, ideally within CPG, Food & Beverage and/or adjacent lifestyle categories.

Agency and/or brand-side experience overseeing complex, integrated creator programs.

Deep expertise in creator partnerships, content strategy, cultural strategy and ROI-driven campaign development.

Strong understanding of creator-led brand building and the role creators can play across the consumer journey and broader marketing mix.

Proven experience leading and developing high-performing teams, including multiple manager-level direct reports.

Strong track record of growing business, including new business development and organic account expansion.

Experience collaborating across regions or markets; North American or global experience is a plus.

We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Organization Overview: The Drug Delivery group at Lilly studies physiological barriers across routes of administration to create novel, patient-centric delivery solutions, serving as a center of excellence in injection physiology, device ideation, novel drug delivery technologies across modalities and routes of administration, nanomedicine and targeted delivery, and connected devices/digital biomarkers. Position Overview: The Director/Sr Director, Long-Acting Injectable & Bio-Nano Interface Characterization anchors a growing technical capability in long-acting injectable (LAI) and depot delivery — spanning polymer and lipid depot platforms (microspheres, in situ forming depots, and liquid-crystal systems, etc.) together with the physicochemical and biological characterization of injectable particle systems, including protein-corona (biocorona) formation at the bio-nano interface — intended to extend dosing intervals, enable higher-concentration and needle-sparing delivery, and de-risk the in vivo fate of injectable biologics, peptides, and nucleic-acid medicines. We are seeking a senior technical leader to define and drive the scientific and translational strategy for these platforms at Lilly, operating at the enterprise level: setting technical direction across programs, representing Lilly externally with academic, clinical, CDMO, and regulatory stakeholders, and mentoring the next generation of scientists and engineers. The role carries accountability for translating long-acting-injectable and bio-nano-interface science from mechanistic understanding into IND- and design-control-ready delivery platforms. Key Responsibilities: Define the scientific vision and multi-year technical strategy for long-acting injectable and depot delivery, aligned with the group's portfolio bets and enterprise R&D priorities, including build-vs-buy and external innovation decisions (licensing, partnerships, sponsored research). Serve as Lilly's internal and external technical authority on injectable depot systems and the bio-nano interface — including release-rate engineering, burst-release control, and protein-corona and biodistribution behavior; lead cross-functional and cross-company teams to translate platform concepts from feasibility through design control, leveraging AI/ML-enabled modeling and data-analysis tools to accelerate technical decision-making. Build and leverage an external network of academic collaborators, CDMOs, consortia, and regulatory bodies (e.g., FDA); represent Lilly's long-acting-injectable and nanoparticle-characterization work in publications, conferences, and regulatory discussions. Design and oversee preclinical release, PK/IVIVC, and biodistribution study strategy with CRO and academic partners to de-risk IND-enabling and design-control decisions; champion breakthrough approaches and make data-driven, sometimes bold, decisions under scientific and technical ambiguity where no precedent exists. Actively mentor and coach scientists and engineers, including staff outside your direct reporting line; identify and help lead scientific or process improvements that draw on diverse thinking across DDCS's broader technical portfolio. Overview

Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.

With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

Business Segment Overview:

Commercial: With boots on the ground authenticity at the heart of everything we do, our comprehensive array of commercial products and services enable you to work directly with our clients, across hedging, risk management, execution and clearing, OTC products, commodity finance and more.

Position Purpose and Impact: The Senior Technology Implementation Specialist plays a critical role in delivering StoneX Supply & Trading’s (SS&T) in-house Commodity Trading and Risk Management (CTRM) software called Nyle. This position will coordinate the delivery of the system across more than 20 global physical commodity trading businesses. Nyle was built on a framework to allow for multi-commodity, multi-currency, and multi-jurisdictional trading to capture a diverse set of businesses as SS&T continues to grow. This role ensures each business is onboarded efficiently and consistently by translating business workflows into system configurations, coordinating with Product Managers and Developers to resolve functionality gaps, managing data migration, and guiding users through testing, go-live, and stabilization. The position is critical to accelerating product adoption, reducing implementation times, and ensuring operational excellence across StoneX’s physical trading platforms.

Responsibilities

Primary duties will include:

• Serve as the primary liaison between physical trading businesses, the Integrations team, and Product to ensure successful onboarding to Nyle.
• Document and design business process models, ensuring each business is aligned with Nyle’s intended workflow and system logic.
• Gather functional requirements from trading, logistics, risk, finance, and back‑office teams and map them to existing Nyle functionality.
• Identify system gaps, enhancements, or workflow inconsistencies and work with Product to define and deliver solutions.
• Lead configuration, parallel runs, user acceptance testing (UAT), and readiness assessments for each implementation.
• Conduct validation testing in lower environments to ensure requirements are met; coordinate with developers to provide feedback and request updates.
• Manage execution of data migration including contracts, hedges, shipments, AP/AR, invoices, payments, and inventory positions.
• Monitor implementation‑related communication channels (Teams chats, ticketing boards, etc.) and provide hands‑on user support, guidance, and escalation.
• Develop standardized implementation playbooks, documentation, and templates to ensure efficiency and consistency across all business rollouts.
• Coordinate training sessions, create reference materials, and guide users through adoption phases.
• Track and report implementation progress, risks, and milestones to leadership.

Qualifications

To land this role you will need:

• 6+ years of experience in commodity trading, physical commodities operations, CTRM systems, or software implementation roles
• Strong understanding of commodity trade lifecycle: contracting, hedging, logistics, settlement, AP/AR, invoicing, and inventory management
• Demonstrated experience translating complex business workflows into system configurations
• Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with the ability to diagnose issues across multiple functional areas
• Excellent communication, documentation, and cross‑functional collaboration skills

What makes you stand out:

• Experience implementing CTRM/ETRM systems within agricultural, energy, metals, or soft‑commodity markets
• Familiarity with product development lifecycles and agile methodologies
• Hands‑on understanding of data migration, system integrations, or process automation tools
• Comfort working in dynamic, fast‑moving, and globally distributed teams

Education / Certification Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Information Systems, Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, or related fields

Working Environment:

• 4 days per week onsite, 1 day per week remote

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The Traffic Proxy Services team powers the front line of Roblox — operating the global edge network and high-performance Layer 7 proxies that handle billions of web and API requests daily while defending the platform against large-scale automated attacks. In this role, you'll help pioneer the next generation of our edge infrastructure: replacing legacy proxy configurations with programmable, memory-safe Rust services running on Kubernetes, and building intelligent, automated defense systems. Working alongside principal engineers and key partners across Security, Reliability, and Platform teams, you'll tackle high-stakes systems challenges where efficiency, scale, and uptime are critical.

You Are:

• An experienced systems engineer with 7+ years building and operating backend or infrastructure software, including time owning a tier-0 service in production.
• Fluent in a systems language. Rust strongly preferred; strong Go experience with the appetite to work in Rust is welcome.
• Deeply comfortable with networking fundamentals: TCP, TLS, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, QUIC and the internals of at least one production L7 proxy (HAProxy, Envoy, NGINX, Pingora or similar). Able to troubleshoot a live network problem.
• Familiar with how the kernel and userspace interact, and comfortable tuning the kernel to optimize for efficiency and reliability.
• Experienced with high-performance packet processing in and around the kernel — kernel-bypass and kernel-path techniques such as eBPF/XDP.
• Able to independently design, build, and operate systems on Kubernetes end to end, and to reason about node-level behavior when latency and resource isolation matter.
• Able to write a design doc that survives review by senior stakeholders across several teams, and to disagree productively when it doesn't.
• Motivated by problems where the blast radius is real and the feedback loop is immediate.
• Genuinely curious. You pull on the thread until you understand why a system behaves the way it does, and you would rather learn an unfamiliar layer of the stack than route around it.

You Will:

• Design and build high-performance services that sit directly in the request data path, where performance, reliability, and security are of utmost priority.
• Effectively leverage AI tools to speed up research, development, and troubleshooting while keeping a critical eye
• Evolve our edge architecture toward something simpler and programmable, migrating policy incrementally with parity testing and exercised rollback.
• Improve traffic classification and intelligence to detect and mitigate DDoS and abuse traffic.
• Build feedback loops that automate mitigation and reduce MTTR.
• Raise the efficiency of the edge
• Own your work in production as part of the team's on-call rotation, and raise the reliability bar through design, code review, incident review.
• Collaborate across Networking, Security, Reliability, and Compute to deliver on Infrastructure and company priorities.
• Be a gatekeeper for a high code quality bar, architectural designs, and pragmatic vs. long-term approaches.
• Uphold our company vision by putting the Roblox community first and exemplifying our values.

ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno believes that Music is a Human Right, a vehicle for community, connection, healing, and learning. The Sr. Manager, Social Impact & Education ensures that Suno lives up to our belief.

This is a new role, an opportunity to define, build, and lead Suno's presence in two critically important spaces: the nonprofit and social impact community, and the educational institutions and platforms that are shaping how the next generation engages with music and technology. You will create the frameworks, forge the partnerships, and establish the practices that allow Suno to make a meaningful and lasting impact beyond the commercial platform.

You are a mission-driven operator: someone who knows how to translate big-picture vision into concrete programs, build trust with organizations that have high standards for the partners they choose, and move with the urgency and creativity that a fast-growing technology company demands. You believe that access to creative tools is a form of equity, and you want to spend your career proving it. This role initially reports to the Chief Music Officer.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/1JUK3wiiyx6X5FzJ

Here's an example of a recent partnership: https://songs-of-love.suno.com/

WHAT YOU’LL DO

SOCIAL IMPACT & NONPROFIT PARTNERSHIPS

- Develop and own Suno's social impact strategy, establishing a clear point of view on the communities, causes, and organizations we exist to serve

- Identify, evaluate, and build relationships with nonprofits, community arts organizations, and mission-aligned institutions where Suno can have genuine, measurable impact

- Design and manage partnership structures, including platform access programs, co-branded initiatives, and grant or donation frameworks, that make Suno meaningfully accessible to underserved communities

- Serve as Suno's primary relationship manager for social impact partners, ensuring consistent communication, mutual value, and long-term commitment

- Collaborate with Marketing, Comms, Legal, and Finance to bring programs to life and ensure they reflect Suno's values and brand

EDUCATION PARTNERSHIPS

- Build Suno's university and education strategy from the ground up, targeting institutions, music programs, and ed-tech platforms where AI music creation has natural curriculum relevance

- Establish and manage formal partnerships with colleges, universities, and music schools, including access agreements, co-developed curriculum materials, and educator support resources

- Identify and cultivate relationships with faculty, department heads, and academic administrators who can champion Suno's role in music education

- Explore integrations and partnerships with established educational platforms and tools to extend Suno's reach into structured learning environments

- Represent Suno at educational conferences, campus events, and relevant academic forums

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL IMPACT

- Work closely with Product to advocate for features and access tiers that serve nonprofit and educational users

- Partner with Comms, Music, and Marketing teams to develop storytelling around Suno's social impact, surfacing the human stories that demonstrate our platform's reach and meaning

- Own the annual social impact and education budget and investment recommendation, presenting priorities to senior leadership

- Track and report on program performance, partnership health, and community impact metrics that inform Suno's broader social impact investment strategy

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & EXPERTISE

- 5-8+ years of experience in partnerships, program management, or community development, ideally spanning both education and nonprofit/social impact sectors

- Demonstrated ability to build programs from scratch, you are comfortable with ambiguity and energized by the work of establishing something new

- Strong relationship-building skills and the credibility to engage senior stakeholders at academic institutions and mission-driven organizations

- Familiarity with the music industry, music education landscape, or AI technology (ideally more than one of these)

- Excellent communication and storytelling skills; you can represent Suno's vision compellingly to audiences who may be skeptical of or unfamiliar with AI

- A genuine belief that creative tools should be accessible to everyone, and the drive to make that belief operational

- Ability to manage multiple partnerships and workstreams simultaneously without losing attention to detail or relationship quality

- Some people-manager experience; may manage internal or external partners supporting program execution in the future

PREFERRED

- Experience at a music technology, streaming, or AI company

- Experience working within or alongside product and engineering teams

- Experience writing and/or performing music

ADDITIONAL NOTES:

- Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

PERKS & BENEFITS

- 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

- 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

- Creative Education Stipend

COMPENSATION:

$175,000 - $235,000 base salary (before equity)

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic is at the forefront of AI research, dedicated to developing safe, ethical, and powerful artificial intelligence. Our mission is to ensure that transformative AI systems are aligned with human interests. We are seeking a Staff level Engineer to join our Pre-training team, responsible for developing the next generation of large language models. In this role, you will work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical engineering, contributing to the development of safe, steerable, and trustworthy AI systems.

Responsibilities

• Design and implement data processing infrastructure for large language model training (highly performant, reproducible, traceable)
• Develop and maintain core processing primitives (e.g., tokenization, deduplication, chunking) with a focus on scalability
• Build robust systems for data quality assurance and validation at scale
• Collaborate with research teams to implement novel data processing architectures
• Build and operate end-to-end data pipelines that turn raw web-scale corpora into training-ready datasets

You may be a good fit if you have:

• 5+ YOE outside of internships
• Strong software engineering skills with experience building high-throughput fault-tolerant distributed systems
• Hands-on experience with distributed computing frameworks, particularly Apache Spark
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
• Strong communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment
• Advanced degree in Computer Science or related field
• Experience with language model training infrastructure
• Background in Data Infrastructure, MLOps, or ML infrastructure

Strong candidates may have:

• Have significant experience building high-throughput fault-tolerant distributed systems
• Expertise with Python and Rust
• Passionate about system reliability and performance
• Are comfortable working with ambiguous requirements and evolving specifications
• Take ownership of problems and drive solutions independently
• Are excited about contributing to the development of safe and ethical AI systems
• Can balance technical excellence with practical delivery
• Are eager to learn about machine learning research and its infrastructure requirements

Sample Projects

• Designing and implementing distributed computing architecture for web-scale data processing
• Building scalable infrastructure for model training data preparation
• Developing fault-tolerant distributed processing systems
• Implementing new infrastructure components based on research requirements

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$500,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

TL;DR:
We're looking for a full-stack engineer who wants to sit at the heart of Lovable's marketing engine - making every pound of spend measurable, and every manual workflow a tool. One sprint you're tracing spend from first click to revenue across Meta, Google and newer channels; the next you're shipping landing pages, experiments or an agent that saves the team hours a week. You think in React and APIs, but your first instinct is always: can we measure it, and does it help us grow faster?

Coding skills + excellent taste + growth instincts + marketing obsession = you.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

- 5+ years of experience building and growing user-facing products in high-performing teams, ideally including growth work, marketplaces/platforms, or communities.

- Strong product sense and UX taste for multi-sided systems with creators, learners, and customers - you can see problems from multiple sides and design for all of them.

- Knowledge of Meta Pixel and Google Ad Network APIs, and experience working with data from ad networks. Experience with TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit and Beehiiv, plus CTV/podcast tracking, is a plus.

- Comfortable using data, funnels, analytics, attribution, and A/B testing to shape what you build and how you iterate.

- Skilled at designing, measuring, and iterating experiments, and thorough in setting up growth systems "right" from the start.

- Experience collaborating across functions (design, marketing, partnerships, support, data) to launch and grow new product surfaces and ecosystems.

- Enjoys designing reusable growth, ecosystem, and monetization tools that other builders can plug into, with a pragmatic and detail-oriented mindset.

- Motivated by helping others succeed and by seeing impact through engagement, measurable results, and revenue - you care about the scoreboard as much as the code.

What you’ll do

In one sentence: You'll sit between marketing and engineering and build whatever we need to grow faster, from the site and tracking to the tools the team uses every day - expect to be driving the thinking here alongside our team leads.

- Build the tools marketing runs on: Find the manual work slowing the team down and replace it with tools, automations or agents, ideally built on Lovable.

- Shape what gets built: Work with design, marketing, data and partnerships to decide what's worth doing, then own it end to end.

- Own how we measure marketing: Make sure every pound of spend can be traced from first click to revenue, across Meta and Google and newer channels like CTV and podcast. This is what lets us scale spend with confidence.

- Make experimentation cheap & fast: Build the events, funnels and A/B testing setup that let the team test an idea in days and double down on what works.

- Turn the website into a growth surface: Ship landing pages, signup flows and first-run moments that get new users to value fast, without waiting in a product queue.

- Keep it Lovable: Growth should feel like part of the product, never bolted on.

Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

- Frontend: React

- Backend: Golang and Rust

- Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers

- DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.
